text: A popular strategy to increase volume by manipulating training frequency is to split up a workout by performing multiple sessions in a day (often morning and evening). This strategy, called a double-split routine , is commonly used by bodybuilders to allow for high weekly training volumes while maintaining optimal mental and physical abilities during training. A study by Häkkinen and Kallinen (90) lends support to the value of double splits for hypertrophy training. Employing a crossover design, female athletes performed 2 training blocks lasting 3 weeks each. The athletes trained once a day during the first block and twice a day during the second block.
